scope: Independent C3/C60 LightGBM HPO and within-head seed-average check; no canonical or live mutation.
architecture: frozen P0 -> O250_H6 -> C3 normalized regret C60/uniform -> K0

selection.reason: Highest strict-OOS mean net EV/trade, strongest worst month and CVaR among all arms passing the predeclared two-era and participation gates.

validation.causality: O/C outer fit uses labels resolved before each held month; inner fit uses labels resolved before each inner validation start; held candidates remain target-free until economic evaluation.
